de.name: Siri Fort
de.text: Diese Festung aus dem 14. Jahrhundert wurde von Alauddin Khalji zum Schutz vor mongolischen Invasionen errichtet.

de.name: Ghiyas-ud-Din Tughlaq's Tomb

de.name: Worlds of Wonder

de.name: Commonwealth Games Sundial

de.text: Dieses moderne Wohnhaus wurde im Jahr 2021 fertiggestellt und dient als privater Familiensitz.

de.name: Tughlakabad Mosque

de.name: Tughlakabad Baoli
de.text: Dieser historische Stufenbrunnen innerhalb des Festungskomplexes diente einst der effizienten Wasserspeicherung und Kühlung.

de.name: Adilabad Fort

de.name: Trialogue Studio

de.name: People Places Arts

ro.name: Worlds of Wonder

ro.name: Masjid Baitul Hadi
ro.text: Această moschee modernă servește ca centru spiritual și loc de rugăciune pentru comunitatea Ahmadiyya.

ro.name: Kalindi Kunj Park
ro.text: Acest parc public este cunoscut pentru grădinile sale îngrijite și spectacolele de seară cu fântâni muzicale.

ro.text: Acest muzeu de artă privat prezintă o colecție importantă de lucrări moderne și contemporane ale artiștilor indieni.

ro.text: Această reședință modernă a fost finalizată în anul 2021 și servește ca locuință privată a unei familii.

en.name: Siri Fort
en.text: This 14th-century fortress was built by Alauddin Khalji to protect the city from Mongol invasions.

en.name: Ghiyas-ud-Din Tughlaq's Tomb
en.text: This 14th-century red sandstone mausoleum with a white marble dome was built within a fortified complex.

en.name: Surajkund
en.text: This ancient reservoir built in the form of an amphitheater is known for its annual international crafts mela.

en.name: Rashtriya Dalit Prerna Sthal and Green Garden
en.text: This massive memorial park features statues of Dalit icons and fountains along the Yamuna riverbank.

en.name: Kalkaji Mandir
en.text: This ancient Hindu temple is dedicated to the goddess Kali and attracts thousands of devotees during Navratri.

en.text: This massive 14th-century stone fortress features high sloping walls and circular bastions characteristic of Tughlaq architecture.

en.name: Worlds of Wonder

en.name: Masjid Baitul Hadi
en.text: This modern mosque serves as a spiritual center and place of worship for the Ahmadiyya community.

en.name: Kalindi Kunj Park
en.text: This public park is known for its manicured gardens and popular musical fountain shows held in the evenings.

en.name: Kiran Nadar Museum of Art

en.name: Commonwealth Games Sundial

en.name: Langer Khan Tomb Gate
en.text: This historic stone gateway is a remnant of a Lodi-era tomb complex, featuring characteristic Islamic arches.

en.name: Zamrudpur Tomb

en.text: This modern residential building was completed in 2021 and serves as a private family residence.

en.name: Tughlakabad Mosque

en.name: Tughlaqabad Palace Ruins

en.name: Tughlakabad Baoli

en.name: Trialogue Studio
en.text: This intimate studio space hosts experimental theatre, creative workshops, and independent artistic performances.

en.name: People Places Arts
en.text: This arts centre fosters the local creative scene through regular exhibitions, workshops, and community projects.

en.name: Theatre Kunzum 2

en.name: Arthshilla
en.text: This multidisciplinary arts centre focuses on promoting visual arts and facilitating cultural exchange through diverse programs.

en.name: Japan Foundation
en.text: This cultural centre promotes Japanese art and language through regular exhibitions, workshops, and cinema screenings.

en.name: Arya Auditorium
en.text: This large auditorium is a popular venue for traditional Indian classical dance and music performances.

en.name: Chittaranjan Park Bangiya Samaj
en.text: This cultural centre is a key hub for the Bengali community, hosting traditional festivals and heritage events.

en.name: Bipin Chandra Pal Memorial Auditorium
en.text: This theatre, named after the prominent nationalist, provides a venue for various cultural productions and dramatic plays.

en.name: IIIT Delhi Open Amphitheatre

descriptionAdvanced.de: Der Lotus-Tempel in Neu-Delhi ist ein Bahai-Haus der Andacht, das 1986 fertiggestellt wurde und für seine markante Form einer sich öffnenden Lotusblüte weltweit bekannt ist. Entworfen wurde das Bauwerk vom iranisch-kanadischen Architekten Fariborz Sahba. Die Struktur besteht aus 27 freistehenden „Blütenblättern“ aus weißem Marmor, die in Dreiergruppen angeordnet sind und so neun Eingänge bilden, die in eine zentrale Halle führen. Diese Halle bietet Platz für bis zu 2.500 Personen und zeichnet sich durch ihre schlichte Eleganz ohne religiöse Symbole oder Altäre aus, was die Bahai-Lehre von der Einheit aller Religionen widerspiegelt. Der Tempel ist von neun Teichen umgeben, die nicht nur der Ästhetik dienen, sondern auch zur natürlichen Kühlung des Gebäudes beitragen. Er ist eine der meistbesuchten religiösen Stätten der Welt und hat zahlreiche Architekturpreise für seine innovative Gestaltung und Nachhaltigkeit gewonnen.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Az Újdelhiben található Lótusz-templom egy bahái imaház, amelyet 1986-ban fejeztek be, és egy nyíló lótuszvirágra emlékeztető formájáról világszerte ismert. Az építményt Fariborz Sahba iráni-kanadai építész tervezte. A szerkezet 27 szabadon álló, fehér márványból készült „sziromból” áll, amelyek hármas csoportokba rendezve kilenc bejáratot alkotnak, melyek a központi csarnokba vezetnek. Ez a csarnok akár 2500 ember befogadására is alkalmas, és egyszerű elegancia jellemzi, vallási szimbólumok vagy oltárok nélkül, ami a bahái hit minden vallás egységére vonatkozó tanítását tükrözi. A templomot kilenc tavacska veszi körül, amelyek nemcsak esztétikai célokat szolgálnak, hanem az épület természetes hűtéséhez is hozzájárulnak. A világ egyik leglátogatottabb vallási helyszíne, amely innovatív tervezéséért és fenntarthatóságáért számos építészeti díjat nyert.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Templul Lotus din New Delhi este o Casă de Adorație Bahá'í finalizată în 1986, celebră în întreaga lume pentru forma sa distinctivă de floare de lotus care se deschide. Edificiul a fost proiectat de arhitectul irano-canadian Fariborz Sahba. Structura este compusă din 27 de „petale” de sine stătătoare din marmură albă, dispuse în grupuri de câte trei pentru a forma nouă intrări care duc spre o sală centrală. Această sală are o capacitate de până la 2.500 de persoane și se remarcă prin eleganța sa simplă, fără simboluri religioase sau altare, reflectând învățătura Bahá'í despre unitatea tuturor religiilor. Templul este înconjurat de nouă iazuri care nu servesc doar esteticii, ci contribuie și la răcirea naturală a clădirii. Este unul dintre cele mai vizitate situri religioase din lume, câștigând numeroase premii de arhitectură pentru designul său inovator și sustenabilitate.
descriptionAdvanced.en: The Lotus Temple in New Delhi is a Bahá'í House of Worship completed in 1986, renowned globally for its striking flowerlike shape. Designed by Iranian-Canadian architect Fariborz Sahba, the structure is composed of 27 free-standing marble-clad "petals" arranged in clusters of three to form nine sides. These nine doors open onto a central hall with a capacity of 2,500 people, notable for its lack of religious icons or altars, aligning with the Bahá'í belief in the unity of all religions. The temple is surrounded by nine ponds that not only enhance its visual appeal but also play a vital role in the building's natural ventilation system. Since its inauguration, it has become one of the most visited religious buildings in the world and has received numerous architectural awards for its innovative design, engineering excellence, and commitment to environmental harmony.
descriptionAdvanced.es: El Templo del Loto en Nueva Delhi es una casa de oración bahá'í terminada en 1986, mundialmente famosa por su forma de flor de loto abriéndose. Diseñado por el arquitecto Fariborz Sahba, consta de 27 'pétalos' de mármol blanco dispuestos en grupos de tres, formando nueve entradas. El interior es un espacio de meditación silencioso, sin símbolos religiosos, reflejando la unidad de todas las religiones. Rodeado por nueve estanques que ayudan a la refrigeración natural, es uno de los sitios religiosos más visitados del mundo y ha recibido numerosos premios por su diseño innovador y sostenibilidad.
descriptionAdvanced.pt: O Templo de Lótus em Nova Deli é uma casa de oração bahá'í concluída em 1986, mundialmente famosa pela sua forma de flor de lótus a abrir. Projetado pelo arquiteto Fariborz Sahba, consiste em 27 'pétalas' de mármore branco dispostas em grupos de três, formando nove entradas. O interior é um espaço de meditação silencioso, sem símbolos religiosos, refletindo a unidade de todas as religiões. Rodeado por nove lagos que ajudam na refrigeração natural, é um dos locais religiosos mais visitados do mundo.
descriptionAdvanced.fr: Le temple du Lotus à New Delhi est une maison d'adoration bahá'íe achevée en 1986. Mondialement célèbre pour sa forme évoquant une fleur de lotus en train d'éclore, il a été conçu par l'architecte Fariborz Sahba. La structure se compose de 27 « pétales » de marbre blanc disposés par groupes de trois, créant neuf entrées menant au hall central. Ce hall peut accueillir 2 500 personnes et prône l'unité des religions, sans symboles religieux ni autels. Entouré de neuf étangs qui assurent un refroidissement naturel, le temple est l'un des sites les plus visités au monde.
